background.prompt: Edit this underwater aquarium background. Remove only the Turkish flag hanging in the far center background and reconstruct the natural underwater rock, distant aquatic vegetation and soft blue water behind it. This area must become an empty natural distant background because a separate animated flag will be layered here in code. Preserve all other scenery, camera framing, wide aspect ratio, red and white edge corals, sandy foreground, water color, rays and realistic lighting as closely as possible. No fish, no text, no new flag, no banner, no decorations or characters. Clean seamless photorealistic result.

Create a lovable Olaf-like snowman in polished cinematic 3D rendering with realistic softly sparkling snow material and smooth rounded surfaces, no low-poly facets. Full-body three-quarter front view, very gentle turn toward viewer, large expressive friendly eyes, raised twig eyebrows, long orange carrot nose, broad joyful smile with two small front teeth, three thin little twig hairs, rounded tall head, two soft snowball body sections, little oval snow feet, three coal buttons, thin twig arms opened in a welcoming pose, tiny fingers. Soft cool underwater fill light and warm soft key light, gentle ambient contact shading. Entire body, fingertips and feet inside frame with small margins. Single isolated character, true transparent alpha background, opaque snow body. No text, scene, fish, ground rectangle, watermark or other objects. Portrait framing, high detail suitable for a crisp small display.
